methods.name: Explainable boosting machine (EBM)
methods.summary: EBM is a fast implementation of the generalized additive models plus interactions (GA2M) method. It uses gradient boosting to iteratively learn shallow decision trees for each predictor variable in a round-robin fashion, allowing for the visualization of one-dimensional feature functions and two-dimensional interaction heat maps for model interpretability.
methods.verbatim: EBM was implemented using Python [90] and the InterpretML library [91]... InterpretML—Alpha Release. InterpretML. 2021. Available online: https://github.com/interpretml/interpret (accessed on 6 December 2021).
